title: Analytic: parallel-plate TEM, TE1 and TM1 modes, uniaxial filling (em_modes)
description:
Two infinite metal plates 0.4 um apart filled with a uniaxial dielectric, optic axis along y (eps_yy = n_e^2 = 4.571, eps_xx = eps_zz = n_o^2 = 4.889: lithium-niobate-like, without material dispersion), seen in cross-section: em_modes with pec on y_lo / y_hi and periodic x (10 cells), uniform 10 nm cells; frequency_domain study over 0.8-1.5 um (15 wavelengths) with the group index on; mode_dispersion follows the TEM mode (mode 1), TE1 (mode 2) and TM1 (mode 3).
Wall plane: each plate sits on the inner face of the outermost cell (a ghost cell), so the gap is d_gap = size_y - 2 dx_cell.
Analytic: TEM (E_y only) n = sqrt(eps_yy) at every wavelength and n_g = n; TE1 (E_x) n^2 = eps_xx - (lambda / (2 d))^2, n_g = eps_xx / n; TM1 (E_y, E_z) n^2 = eps_yy (1 - (lambda / (2 d))^2 / eps_zz), n_g = eps_yy / n. Each of the three permittivity components enters a different mode.
Spectra tab: modes.tem / te1 / tm1, quantity n_eff or n_group, with the analytic curves dashed.
Derived values tab at lambda0 = 1 um: the TEM n_eff and n_group agree to the eigen-solve (~1e-6 or better: with the plates on the wall planes the discrete TEM mode is exact); TE1 / TM1 n_eff and n_group ~1.2e-4 (the discrete transverse wavenumber (2/h) sin(pi h / (2 d)) lies below pi / d: second order in dx_cell); n_eff_TE1_discrete uses that wavenumber and agrees to ~1e-6; te_fraction 1 for TE1 (E_x only) and 0 for TM1.
Curves & tables / Field tab: the last wavelength (1.5 um).

parameters.name: d_gap
parameters.description: plate gap between the y wall planes (40 cells)

parameters.name: eps_e
parameters.description: extraordinary permittivity n_e^2 (eps_yy, optic axis along y)

parameters.name: lambda0
parameters.description: wavelength of the derived values (one of the study wavelengths)

parameters.name: n_tem
parameters.description: analytic TEM n_eff = n_group (E_y sees eps_yy)

parameters.name: K_1_discrete
parameters.description: discrete transverse wavenumber of the first order between the wall planes [1/m]

parameters.name: n_te1_discrete
parameters.description: TE1 n_eff of the discrete (Yee) cross-section at lambda0

parameters.name: lambda_cut_1
parameters.description: cutoff wavelength of TE1 and TM1 (both set by n_o) [m]
